theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lr_local_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (h : Euclid d → Euclid d) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → v₀ ∈ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h V → fderiv ℝ h v₀ = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid d) → ∃ (V₀ O : Set (Euclid d)) (k : Euclid d → Euclid d), IsOpen V₀ ∧ IsOpen O ∧ V₀ ⊆ V ∧ v₀ ∈ V₀ ∧ MapsTo h V₀ O ∧ MapsTo k O V₀ ∧ (∀ v ∈ V₀, k (h v) = v) ∧ (∀ u ∈ O, h (k u) = u) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 k O ∧ fderiv ℝ k (h v₀) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid d)
